# Face test fixture

`astronaut_256.jpg` is the "astronaut" sample image from scikit-image
(`skimage.data.astronaut`), downscaled to 256x256. It is a NASA photograph of
astronaut Eileen Collins and is in the public domain
(https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Eileen_Collins.jpg).

It is used only to run the real YuNet/SFace models in tests
(`tests/test_services/test_face_recognition_models.py`).
